name: TV Back Bridge
overview: Make TV remote Back work in Jellyfin Web
description: Maps a TV remote Back key to Jellyfin Web navigation. Tested on a Toshiba VIDAA TV, with configurable key matching and an on-screen key viewer.

versions.changelog: Configurable user-agent matching; blank enables on every device. Adds Reset to defaults. Jellyfin 12 build passes local tests but is NOT tested on a Jellyfin 12 server or TV.
Configurable user-agent matching; blank enables on every device. Adds Reset to defaults. Jellyfin 10.11.5 build passes local tests; this release needs a TV test.
Jellyfin 12.0.0 build from the same source. Compiles and passes a local smoke test; NOT tested on a Jellyfin 12 server or TV.
Initial release candidate for Jellyfin 10.11.5. Defaults to Backspace (8). Includes configurable key matching and a key viewer that displays the physical remote event.
